lessons.title: Starting Meaningful Conversations
lessons.subtitle: شروع مکالمه و ادامه‌دادن گفتگو به‌شکل طبیعی
lessons.goal: با سؤال‌های باز، مکالمه را از احوال‌پرسی ساده فراتر ببر.
lessons.conversation:
Alex: How have things been going on your end lately?
Sam: Pretty well, actually. I've been trying to strike a better balance between work and free time.
Alex: That sounds worthwhile. What prompted that change?
Sam: I realized I was constantly checking emails, even during dinner.
Alex: I can relate to that. Has anything made a noticeable difference?
Sam: Setting clearer boundaries has helped more than I expected.

phrases.en: How have things been going on your end?
phrases.fa: اوضاع از طرف تو چطور پیش می‌رود؟
phrases.example: How have things been going on your end since the move?

phrases.fa: چه چیزی باعث این تغییر شد؟
phrases.example: What prompted that change in your priorities?

phrases.fa: کاملاً می‌توانم با این موضوع هم‌ذات‌پنداری کنم.
phrases.example: I can relate to that; I used to feel the same way.
A small daily habit can make a noticeable difference.

questions.prompt: What is one habit you have changed recently, and why?
questions.tip: دلیل تغییر و نتیجه‌اش را با دو یا سه جمله بگو.

questions.prompt: How do you usually keep a conversation going with someone new?
questions.tip: دو سؤال باز مثال بزن.

questions.prompt: Describe a change in your daily routine that made a noticeable difference.
questions.tip: از because، although یا however استفاده کن.

lessons.title: Handling Work Meetings
lessons.subtitle: بیان نظر، شفاف‌سازی و جمع‌بندی جلسه
lessons.goal: در جلسه کاری مودبانه نظر بده و قدم بعدی را روشن کن.
lessons.conversation:
Maya: Before we move on, could we clarify the main objective?
Noah: Absolutely. We want to reduce response times without compromising quality.
Maya: That makes sense. From my perspective, we should test the new process with a small team first.
Noah: I see your point. What would that involve in practice?
Maya: A two-week trial, followed by feedback from the people involved.
Noah: Great. Let's agree on the next steps before we wrap up.

phrases.example: Before we move on, can I raise one concern?
From my perspective, the deadline is too ambitious.

phrases.en: What would that involve in practice?
phrases.fa: این در عمل شامل چه چیزهایی می‌شود؟
phrases.example: What would that involve in practice for our team?
Let’s wrap up by assigning responsibilities.

questions.prompt: Suggest a small change that could make meetings more effective.
questions.tip: پیشنهاد + دلیل + نتیجه مورد انتظار.

questions.prompt: Ask a colleague to clarify a confusing point politely.
questions.tip: از Could you clarify... استفاده کن.

questions.prompt: Summarize the next steps after a project meeting.
questions.tip: دو اقدام و مسئول هرکدام را مشخص کن.

lessons.title: Disagreeing Diplomatically
lessons.subtitle: مخالفت محترمانه و ساخت استدلال
lessons.goal: مخالفت کن بدون اینکه رابطه را تخریب کنی.
lessons.conversation:
Lee: I think we should launch everything at once.
Jordan: I can see where you're coming from, but I'm not entirely convinced.
Lee: What's your main concern?
Jordan: If we release all the features together, it may be harder to identify problems.
Lee: That's a fair point. What would you suggest instead?
Jordan: A phased launch might be a more practical approach.
Lee: I'm open to that, provided we keep the overall deadline in mind.

phrases.en: I can see where you’re coming from.
phrases.example: I can see where you’re coming from, although I see it differently.
I’m not entirely convinced that this is the best option.

phrases.fa: نکته منصفانه و قابل قبولی است.
phrases.example: That’s a fair point; we should consider the cost.
I agree, provided that we review the results monthly.

questions.prompt: A friend says online learning is always better than classroom learning. Disagree politely.
questions.tip: ابتدا نظرش را درک کن، بعد دلیل مخالف بیاور.

questions.prompt: Explain why rushing a decision can be risky.
questions.tip: یک مثال واقعی یا فرضی ارائه کن.

questions.prompt: Find a compromise between speed and quality.
questions.tip: از provided that یا as long as استفاده کن.

lessons.title: Travel Problems and Solutions
lessons.subtitle: مدیریت مشکل سفر و درخواست کمک
lessons.goal: مشکل را دقیق توضیح بده و راه‌حل بخواه.
lessons.conversation:
Traveler: Excuse me, I believe my luggage was sent to the wrong destination.
Agent: I'm sorry to hear that. Could you give me your baggage reference number?
Traveler: Certainly. I'd appreciate it if you could tell me what happens next.
Agent: We'll track it and arrange delivery as soon as possible.
Traveler: Is there a realistic estimate for when it might arrive?
Agent: We expect an update within twenty-four hours.
Traveler: Thank you. Could you keep me informed if anything changes?

phrases.en: I believe there has been a mix-up.
phrases.fa: فکر می‌کنم اشتباهی رخ داده است.
phrases.example: I believe there has been a mix-up with my reservation.

phrases.en: I’d appreciate it if you could ...
phrases.example: I’d appreciate it if you could check the details.
Could you give me a realistic estimate of the delay?
Please keep me informed of any updates.

questions.prompt: Your flight has been cancelled. Ask for practical alternatives.
questions.tip: مشکل را بگو، گزینه‌ها و زمان‌بندی را بپرس.

questions.prompt: A hotel has given you the wrong room type. Explain the issue politely.
questions.tip: از I believe there has been a mix-up استفاده کن.

questions.prompt: Ask for an update about delayed luggage without sounding rude.
questions.tip: از I’d appreciate it if you could... استفاده کن.

lessons.title: Telling a Compelling Story
lessons.subtitle: داستان‌گویی همراه با جزئیات و نتیجه
lessons.goal: روایت را با زمینه، اتفاق، واکنش و نتیجه سازمان‌دهی کن.
lessons.conversation:
Nina: Have I ever told you about the time I missed my train in a foreign city?
Omar: No, what happened?
Nina: At first, I panicked because my phone battery was almost dead. To make matters worse, I didn't speak the local language.
Omar: That sounds stressful.
Nina: Surprisingly, a stranger offered to help me find a different route.
Omar: So it worked out in the end?
Nina: It did. Looking back, it taught me to stay calm and ask for help.

phrases.example: To make matters worse, it started raining heavily.
Much to my surprise, the interview went smoothly.
Looking back, I should have prepared more carefully.
It turned out that we had the wrong address.

questions.prompt: Tell a story about a time when your plans went wrong.
questions.tip: ابتدا موقعیت، سپس مشکل و سرانجام نتیجه را بگو.

questions.prompt: Describe an unexpected act of kindness you have seen.
questions.tip: از Much to my surprise استفاده کن.

questions.prompt: Share a mistake that taught you something important.
questions.tip: در پایان از Looking back استفاده کن.

lessons.title: Job Interviews with Confidence
lessons.subtitle: معرفی توانایی‌ها با مثال و اعتمادبه‌نفس
lessons.goal: به پرسش‌های مصاحبه ساختارمند و طبیعی پاسخ بده.
lessons.conversation:
Interviewer: Tell me about a challenge you've faced at work or during a project.
Candidate: Certainly. In a recent project, we had a very tight deadline and limited resources.
Interviewer: How did you handle it?
Candidate: I broke the task into smaller priorities and kept everyone updated.
Interviewer: What was the outcome?
Candidate: We delivered the essential features on time. More importantly, the experience strengthened my ability to make decisions under pressure.

phrases.en: One of my key strengths is ...
phrases.fa: یکی از نقاط قوت اصلی من ... است.
phrases.example: One of my key strengths is staying calm under pressure.

phrases.en: What I learned from that experience was ...
phrases.fa: چیزی که از آن تجربه یاد گرفتم ...
phrases.example: What I learned from that experience was the value of teamwork.
I took the initiative to improve the workflow.
The outcome was a faster, more reliable process.

questions.prompt: Tell me about yourself and your main strengths.
questions.tip: ساختار: معرفی کوتاه، توانایی، یک مثال.

questions.prompt: Describe a difficult situation and how you solved it.
questions.tip: از Situation–Action–Result استفاده کن.

questions.prompt: Why would you be a good fit for this role?
questions.tip: به یک نیاز شغل و یک توانایی خودت اشاره کن.

lessons.title: Discussing Technology and AI
lessons.subtitle: بررسی فرصت‌ها و محدودیت‌های فناوری
lessons.goal: فواید و ریسک‌ها را با دیدی متعادل توضیح بده.
lessons.conversation:
Ava: Do you think AI will fundamentally change how we learn languages?
Ben: To a certain extent, yes. It can offer immediate feedback and personalized practice.
Ava: But couldn't learners become overly dependent on it?
Ben: That's a legitimate concern. Technology should complement human interaction rather than replace it.
Ava: So you would use it selectively?
Ben: Exactly. The key is to strike a balance between convenience and genuine communication.

phrases.example: To a certain extent, technology improves accessibility.
That’s a legitimate concern, especially regarding privacy.
AI should complement rather than replace human judgment.
We need to strike a balance between speed and accuracy.

questions.prompt: How could AI improve language learning without replacing teachers?
questions.tip: دست‌کم یک فایده و یک محدودیت بگو.

questions.prompt: Should people trust AI-generated information?
questions.tip: پاسخی متعادل با on the one hand / on the other hand بده.

questions.prompt: What is one technology you would choose to use less often?
questions.tip: دلایل و جایگزین عملی پیشنهاد کن.

lessons.title: Making and Defending Opinions
lessons.subtitle: نظر دادن در موضوعات پیچیده
lessons.goal: نظر خود را با دلیل، مثال و شرط روشن کن.
lessons.conversation:
Daria: Should companies allow employees to work remotely all the time?
Eli: Broadly speaking, remote work can improve flexibility.
Daria: So you're in favor of it?
Eli: On balance, yes, although it depends on the role and the team.
Daria: What about collaboration?
Eli: That's where a hybrid arrangement may be preferable. Ultimately, the goal should be better outcomes, not simply fewer office hours.

phrases.example: Broadly speaking, flexible work benefits many employees.
On balance, I think the advantages outweigh the drawbacks.

phrases.fa: این تا حد زیادی بستگی دارد به ...
phrases.example: That depends largely on the nature of the task.
Ultimately, long-term results matter more than short-term gains.

questions.prompt: Should students be allowed to use phones in class?
questions.tip: نظر + یک دلیل + استثنا.

questions.prompt: Is working from home better than working in an office?
questions.tip: دو طرف بحث را بررسی کن.

questions.prompt: Should cities invest more in parks or roads?
questions.tip: یک انتخاب کن و با یک مثال از آن دفاع کن.

lessons.title: Negotiating and Compromising
lessons.subtitle: چانه‌زنی و رسیدن به توافق
lessons.goal: درخواست، محدودیت و پیشنهاد جایگزین را شفاف بیان کن.
lessons.conversation:
Client: We would like the project completed by Friday.
Developer: I understand the urgency. However, that timeline could affect quality.
Client: Is there any flexibility on your side?
Developer: We could deliver the core functionality by Friday, provided the additional features move to next week.
Client: That sounds reasonable. Can you put the revised plan in writing?
Developer: Of course. I'll send a breakdown of the milestones this afternoon.

phrases.example: I understand the urgency, but we need time to test.

phrases.fa: آیا در مورد ... انعطافی وجود دارد؟
phrases.example: Is there any flexibility on the deadline?
We could meet halfway and split the extra cost.
We can agree, provided that the scope remains fixed.

questions.prompt: Negotiate a deadline that seems unrealistic.
questions.tip: با احترام نگرانی را مطرح و پیشنهاد جایگزین ارائه کن.

questions.prompt: Ask for a discount without sounding demanding.
questions.tip: از Is there any flexibility on... استفاده کن.

questions.prompt: Suggest a compromise between two colleagues.
questions.tip: منافع هر دو طرف را در نظر بگیر.

lessons.title: Responding to Complaints
lessons.subtitle: پاسخ حرفه‌ای به نارضایتی
lessons.goal: همدلی نشان بده، مسئله را روشن و راه‌حل را مشخص کن.
lessons.conversation:
Customer: I've contacted support twice, but the issue still hasn't been resolved.
Agent: I understand how frustrating that must be, and I'm sorry for the inconvenience.
Customer: What can you do about it?
Agent: Let me look into the details and see what went wrong.
Customer: I'd like a clear timeframe this time.
Agent: That's completely reasonable. I'll follow up by tomorrow with a specific update.

phrases.en: I understand how frustrating that must be.
phrases.fa: درک می‌کنم که چقدر آزاردهنده است.
phrases.example: I understand how frustrating that must be after two delays.
Let me look into that and get back to you.

phrases.en: I appreciate you bringing this to my attention.
phrases.fa: ممنون که این موضوع را اطلاع دادید.
phrases.example: I appreciate you bringing this to my attention.
I’ll follow up by Monday with an update.

questions.prompt: A customer says an order arrived damaged. Respond professionally.
questions.tip: همدلی + بررسی + اقدام بعدی.

questions.prompt: You received poor service at a café. Make a polite complaint.
questions.tip: مسئله و انتظار منطقی خود را بیان کن.

questions.prompt: A teammate complains about delayed feedback. Reply constructively.
questions.tip: مسئولیت‌پذیری و زمان پیگیری را نشان بده.

lessons.title: Media and Current Affairs
lessons.subtitle: بحث متعادل درباره خبر و رسانه
lessons.goal: منبع، شواهد و عدم قطعیت را در گفتگو وارد کن.
lessons.conversation:
Mina: I saw a headline claiming that social media is ruining attention spans.
Theo: That sounds a bit sweeping. Do you know what evidence the article relied on?
Mina: Not really. I only read the headline.
Theo: Then I'd reserve judgment until we look at the actual study.
Mina: Fair enough. Even so, it raises an interesting question about our habits.
Theo: Absolutely. We can discuss the concern without assuming the claim is entirely accurate.

phrases.fa: این ادعا کمی کلی‌گویانه به نظر می‌رسد.
phrases.example: That sounds a bit sweeping; experiences vary widely.

phrases.fa: چه شواهدی آن ادعا را پشتیبانی می‌کند؟
phrases.example: What evidence supports that claim about screen time?
I’d reserve judgment until I read the full report.

phrases.fa: این پرسش جالبی را مطرح می‌کند.
phrases.example: It raises an interesting question about public trust.

questions.prompt: How do you decide whether an online article is trustworthy?
questions.tip: منبع، تاریخ و شواهد را توضیح بده.

questions.prompt: Discuss whether social media helps or harms public discussion.
questions.tip: با یک مثال و یک استثنا.

questions.prompt: What should people do before sharing a surprising headline?
questions.tip: دو اقدام عملی پیشنهاد کن.

lessons.title: Reflecting on Personal Growth
lessons.subtitle: صحبت درباره پیشرفت، هدف و برنامه آینده
lessons.goal: درباره تغییرات زندگی با ظرافت، مثال و نگاه به آینده حرف بزن.
lessons.conversation:
Rosa: What's something you've become better at over the past year?
Kai: I've grown more comfortable speaking up, even when I'm unsure of myself.
Rosa: What helped you make that progress?
Kai: Consistent practice, mostly. I also stopped expecting every conversation to be perfect.
Rosa: Has that changed how you approach challenges?
Kai: Definitely. I'm more willing to take calculated risks and learn as I go.
Rosa: That's a mindset worth holding on to.

phrases.example: I’ve grown more comfortable with expressing my views.

phrases.en: It took me a while to realize ...
phrases.example: It took me a while to realize that mistakes are useful.
Learning a new skill often requires calculated risks.
I don’t know everything yet, but I’ll learn as I go.

questions.prompt: How have your priorities changed in the last two years?
questions.tip: گذشته و حال را مقایسه کن.

questions.prompt: Describe a skill you developed through consistent practice.
questions.tip: مانع، تلاش، نتیجه.

questions.prompt: What would you like to be able to do confidently next year?
questions.tip: هدف روشن و گام‌های عملی بگو.
